Experience the timeless magic of Pandit Jasraj, one of India's greatest classical vocalists, as he presents a soulful journey through some of the most celebrated ragas.
Immerse yourself in the divine world of Indian classical music with mesmerizing renditions of Bhairavi, Jaijaiwanti, Darbari Kanada, and more.
Best of Pandit Jasraj | Raga - Bhairavi, Puriya, Jaijaiwanti, Gauri | Sitar Music | Classical Songs
